title: Event trigger index
description: Flat list the port loop queries. The engine forms a key from (current port, facility underfoot, current chapter) and, for 'stage' entries, from a story-stage/flag instead of location. First match wins; facility 'default' is the port-wide fallback.

chapter.description: Section index in SNRn.DAT; the engine's current-chapter counter selects this.

type.description: 'facility' = fires on entering a facility at a port; 'stage' = fires by story stage/flag, location-independent (id high byte 0xA0-0xA3).

port.description: Port id where a 'facility' event fires (event-id high byte). null for 'stage' events.

event.description: Reference to events/snr{n}.json -> chapter -> label, e.g. 'snr1/c0/L002c'.
